sonnet.problem: This story card retells Daniel 9:5 right after card 5 already asked about it. It only repeats the 'we' point the choice card just covered and adds nothing new, so it works as a recap.

sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.
